rules.startText: 10 forces in Arrakeen, 10 forces in reserves (off\-planet), 10 spice, and 1 random Treachery card.

advantages.text: You have limited prescience.

advantages.title: Spice Vision
advantages.text: Any time during the Shipping and Movement phase, you may look at the top card of the Spice deck.

advantages.title: Bidding Insight
advantages.text: During the Bidding phase, you may look at each Treachery card as it comes up for auction before any faction bids on it. You, and only you, may keep written records about Treachery cards.

advantages.title: Battle Prescience: Vulnerable to Karama
advantages.text:
During the Battle phase, you may force your opponent to reveal to you your choice of one of the four elements they will use in their Battle Plan: the leader (disc or Cheap Hero), Treachery card in the Weapon slot, Treachery card in the Defense slot, or number of force strength dialed plus spice strength. An opponent revealing that they are not playing the particular element asked (e.g. no leader, an empty slot or zero strength) does not allow you to then demand to see another element instead.

Vulnerable to Karama: Karama can be played to cancel this effect immediately after you have named what you are using Battle Prescience to see.

advantages.title: Kwisatz Haderach
advantages.text:
The Kwisatz Haderach token starts out inactive. Use the Kwisatz Haderach card and counter token to publicly keep track of force losses. Immediately after you have lost 7 or more forces in battle (even from a Traitor call), the Kwisatz Haderach token becomes active for the rest of the game and may be added to your Battle Plan (along with a leader) in one territory per round; used as follows:

\- Add +2 strength to your Battle Total if the leader or Cheap Hero is not killed.

\- A leader accompanied by the Kwisatz Haderach cannot be called as a Traitor.

\- The Kwisatz Haderach can only be killed if blown up by a Lasgun/Shield explosion. If killed, the Kwisatz Haderach may be your 1 leader revival during the Revival phase (even if you have not yet triggered leader revival) for 2 spice.

\- The Kwisatz Haderach does not need to die for you to be able to revive your other leaders and can be revived before all your other leaders have died.

fate.title: Karama Power - Golden Path
fate.text:
The following one\-time ability is triggered by playing a Karama card:

Look at any one player's entire Battle Plan (not just your opponent). This cannot be canceled by Karama.

Spirit World Variant: Family Atomics.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may force your ally's opponent to reveal one element of their Battle Plan to you and your ally, following the rules of your Battle Prescience advantage, subject to Karama.

troops.name: Fighter
troops.description: Standard forces. The reverse face is an advisor.

back.name: Advisor
back.description: Advisors have no effect on other factions and cannot battle or collect spice.

rules.startText: After Fremen placement (if in the game), start with one force token in any territory of your choice. If alone, place it as a fighter; if sharing a territory with another faction, place it as an advisor. 19 forces in reserves (off\-planet), 5 spice, and 1 random Treachery card.

advantages.text: You are adept in the ways of mind control.

advantages.title: Prediction
advantages.text: After step 1 of Game Setup (Positions), you secretly predict when one other specific faction will win, placing a Round Number card and a Faction card from your Prediction cards face down behind your Faction Screen. Place the unused Prediction cards face down back in the box. If the faction you predicted wins (alone or as an ally, even your ally) in the round you predicted, reveal your Prediction and win alone. You also can win normally. You cannot predict a win achieved via an advantage titled "Special Victory Condition".

advantages.title: Voice: Vulnerable to Karama
advantages.text:
You may force your opponent to play or not play any Treachery card matching a general type you name of weapon or defense (kinetic, poison, or special) in a Weapon or Defense slot in their Battle Plan. Other cards that could be played in a Battle Plan are not affected by Voice (e.g., Cheap Hero, Worthless cards, or Reinforcements). A card that is labeled as both special and kinetic/poison is affected by either command (e.g., Shield\-Snooper). If your opponent cannot comply with your command, they do not have to admit their inability to comply and instead may do as they wish.

Vulnerable to Karama: Karama can be played to cancel this effect immediately after you have declared how you intend to use Voice.

advantages.title: Transmutation
advantages.text:
You may use a Worthless Treachery card as a Karama card, canceling another faction's vulnerable advantage.

Alternatively, you may use a Worthless card as a Solaris card to buy a Treachery card for free when it is your turn to bid, allow any faction to ship at Spacing Guild shipping rates when they make a Shipping action, paid to the Spice Bank, or pay the cost of your spice strength in a battle from the Spice Bank.

advantages.title: Charity
advantages.text: You always receive CHOAM Charity of 2 spice regardless of how much spice you already have. This amount increases or decreases if any effect modifies CHOAM Charity.

advantages.title: Dual Forces
advantages.text: Your forces have two sides, the striped advisor side and the fighter side without stripes. Fighters are considered standard forces. You can never have both types of tokens in the same territory, nor flip from one type to the other in order to ship or move to a territory containing tokens of the other type (i.e., flip fighters to advisors to join advisors already present, or vice versa) except by deploying an advisor using Spiritual Advisors \- see below.

advantages.title: Spiritual Advisors
advantages.text:
Whenever any other faction ships forces onto Dune from off\-planet, you may deploy 1 advisor for free from your reserves into that same territory or into Polar Sink as a fighter. If the faction is shipping to a territory where you have one or more fighters, you may flip those fighters to advisors in order to deploy an advisor there. Your forces can only go to Dune as advisors when accompanying another faction's shipment in this manner.

Any time before the Shipping and Movement phase begins, in any or all territories in which you have advisors, you may flip all of those advisors to fighters, announcing that you are doing so. Advisors may not otherwise flip to fighters. Advisors have no effect on the

play of the other factions whatsoever (even with your ally), and cannot collect spice, be involved in combat, prevent another faction's control of a stronghold, block a stronghold, use ornithopters, or allow you to play Family Atomics. Advisors are still susceptible to storms, sandworms, Lasgun/Shield explosions, atomics, and can trigger Terror tokens when entering a stronghold containing one.

advantages.title: Fighters
advantages.text:
When shipping on your turn you may only ship fighters, either into a territory where you already have fighters, or where you have no tokens (subject to storm and occupancy rules). When you move fighters into a territory occupied by another faction where you had no forces, they may instead flip to advisors (and must do so if ending their movement in a territory with your ally).

When another faction deploys, ships, or moves into a territory on Dune where you have fighters, you may immediately flip them to advisors.

Karama Power \- None.

alliance.text: You may use your Voice advantage on your ally's opponent in battle, subject to Karama

troops.name: Sardaukar
troops.description: Sardaukar forces are worth 2 forces in battle, except against Fremen.

rules.startText: 20 forces in reserves (off\-planet), 10 spice, and 1 random Treachery card.

advantages.text: You have access to great wealth and elite forces.

advantages.title: Majority Share
advantages.text: Whenever any other faction pays spice for a Treachery card during Bidding, they pay it to you instead of the Spice Bank. You cannot discount the price of Treachery cards; the full price must be paid. Your own payments go to the Spice Bank normally.

advantages.title: Sardaukar: Vulnerable to Karama
advantages.text:
Your five special forces, elite Sardaukar, are worth two standard forces in battle for dialing, and taking losses, though against the Fremen they are worth just one force each. Sardaukar are treated as a single force token for revival and shipping; however, only one Sardaukar force can be revived normally per round (additional Sardaukar may be revived by your one\-time Karama power, see below, or the Tleilaxu Ghola Treachery card).

Vulnerable to Karama: Karama may be played while Battle Plans are being formed to force your Sardaukar to count as one force each for that battle.

advantages.title: Examples of Sardaukar after battle
advantages.text:
Sardaukar and two standard forces:

If you dial a 2, you can spend 2 spice for a +1 spice strength \- if you win, you can either send two standard forces to the Tleilaxu Tanks or one Sardaukar.

If you instead dial a 4, you can spend 4 spice for a +2 spice strength \- if you win, you can either send both Sardaukar to the Tleilaxu Tanks, or one Sardaukar and both standard forces.

Emperor Force

Sardaukar Force

fate.title: Karama Power - War Machine
fate.text:
The following one\-time ability is triggered by playing a Karama card

During the Revival Phase revive up to four forces (including Sardaukar) and one leader for free. These revivals do not count against your normal revivals for the round.

Spirit World Variant: Cheap Hero.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may give any amount of your spice to your ally at the end of any phase. Unlike spice exchanged for bribe and deals, this spice is placed directly behind your ally's Faction Screen. Additionally, when your ally spends spice in Battles for spice strength, the cost is half. For example, to gain +2, it costs your ally 2 spice instead of 4.

troops.name: Fedaykin
troops.description: Fedaykin are worth 2 normal forces in battle.

rules.startText: 10 forces distributed as you like in Sietch Tabr, False Wall South, and/or False Wall West; 10 forces in reserves (in the southern hemisphere of Dune), 4 spice, and 1 random Treachery card.

advantages.text: You are native to Dune and know its ways.

advantages.title: Storm Shelter
advantages.text:
Only half (rounded up) of your force tokens (standard or Fedaykin) caught in a storm are required to be killed, regardless of their strength (although you may choose to allow more or all of them to go to the Tleilaxu Tanks).

You may also ship, move your force tokens one territory, and ride sandworms into a storm at that half loss rate.

advantages.title: Storm Insight
advantages.text: At the end of the Storm phase, you may look at the top card of the Storm deck.

advantages.title: Wormriders
advantages.text: If Shai\-Hulud appears in any territories where you have forces, they are not devoured. Upon conclusion of the Nexus, you may "Ride the Worm", moving some or all of the forces in those territories to any territory subject to storm loss and occupancy rules (any spice or forces in the destination territory are not destroyed).

advantages.title: Call Sandworms
advantages.text: During the Spice Blow and Nexus phase, all subsequent Shai\-Hulud that appear after the first one drawn that phase may be placed by you in any sand territory you wish at the end of the Nexus, devouring any spice or opposing forces there. If placed in a territory where you or your ally have forces, they may Ride the Worm.

advantages.title: Indigenous
advantages.text: Your reserves are already on\-planet; you do not ship using off\-planet shipment rules. For your Force Shipment, deploy any or all of your reserves for free into The Great Flat or directly into any one territory within a distance of two territories of The Great Flat (subject to storm loss and occupancy rules).

advantages.title: Sandwalk
advantages.text: During your Force Movement you may move your forces two territories instead of one.

advantages.title: Fedaykin
advantages.text:
Your three starred forces, Fedaykin, are worth two normal forces in battle and in taking losses. They are each treated as one force in revival; however, only one Fedaykin force can be revived normally per round (except by use of the Tleilaxu Ghola Treachery card).

Fremen Force Fedaykin Force

advantages.title: Battle Edge: Vulnerable to Karama
advantages.text:
You do not spend spice for spice strength, but automatically gain the spice strength simply by dialing the required number of forces.

Vulnerable to Karama: Karama may be played while Battle Plans are being formed. If this advantage is canceled by Karama, you may still spend spice normally for spice strength.

fate.title: Karama Power - Bless The Maker
fate.text:
The following one\-time ability is triggered by playing a Karama card:

Call a Shai\-Hulud during the Spice Blow and Nexus phase. This is counted as if Shai\-Hulud was drawn, but you immediately decide if sandworms appear in the territories of the last Spice Blows card, or if a sandworm will be placed in any sand territory by you at the end of the Nexus (as if using Call Sandworms).

Spirit World Variant: Harj.

### SPECIAL VICTORY CONDITION

If no faction has won by the end of round 10, and if you (or your ally, or no faction) occupy Sietch Tabr and Cave of Birds, and neither House Atreides, House Harkonnen, House Richese, nor Emperor occupies Tuek's Sietch (unless allied with you), then you (and your ally) win the game.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may protect your allies from being devoured by sandworms and allow them to Ride the Worm after the Nexus. You may also allow your ally to increase their free revival to 3 forces. In addition, your ally wins with you if you win with the Fremen Special Victory Condition.

rules.startText: 10 forces in Carthag, 10 forces in reserves (off\-planet), 10 spice, and 2 random Treachery cards.

advantages.text: You excel at treachery.

advantages.title: Traitors
advantages.text: At the start of the game, keep all 4 Traitor cards you are dealt. If you have drawn any of your own leaders, you may reveal some or all of them, and then set them aside. Before any other Traitor cards are returned to the Traitor deck by other players, redraw that many cards from the Traitor deck if possible. Keep the new ones, even if any are your leaders, and then shuffle the set aside cards back into the deck.

advantages.title: Treachery
advantages.text: Your hand limit is 8 Treachery cards; when you have 8 Treachery cards you must pass during bidding. Every time you buy a Treachery card you must take an extra Treachery card for free from the top of the Treachery deck unless it would put you over your hand limit.

advantages.title: Capture Leaders: Vulnerable to Karama
advantages.text:
When you win a battle, you may choose to capture a leader from your opponent. Randomly select 1 available leader (including the leader used in the battle, if not killed, but excluding all leaders used elsewhere that round, already captured, or in the Tleilaxu Tanks). After secretly looking at the captured leader you must decide to either 1) place the leader in the Tleilaxu Tanks to gain 2 spice from the Spice Bank; or 2) keep the leader behind your Screen for a one\-time use in any of your battles. If used in a battle, and not killed, you must then return that leader to its faction. The identity of the captured leader is not required to be revealed.

When all of your own Leader discs are unavailable to you (killed, captured, or face up on the board from previous battles), you must immediately return all captured leaders to their factions. Killed captured leaders can be revived by their factions (subject to the normal revival rules). Captured leaders used in battle may still be claimed as a Traitor (subject to the normal Traitor rules): If you use a leader against its own faction and they are holding that leader's Traitor card as a [uncertain: "safe leader"], it may be revealed as a Traitor, winning them the battle in accordance with normal rules for revealing a Traitor.

Vulnerable to Karama: Karama may be played to cancel your Capture Leaders advantage immediately after you win a battle, but before the captured leader is drawn.

fate.title: Karama Power - Vendetta
fate.text:
The following one\-time ability is triggered by playing a Karama card:

At the end of the Bidding phase, take a random Treachery card from each other player and one from the top of the Treachery deck into your hand. Then choose one card from your hand to give to each player (and discard one if you have 9 cards). This action has no effect on your hand limit.

Spirit World Variant: Solaris.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: Traitor cards that you hold may be used against your ally's opponent if you so choose. The results of their battle are treated as if your ally called Traitor.

rules.startText: 20 forces in reserves (off\-planet), 8 spice and 1 random Treachery card. After step 5 of Game Setup (Forces), you must make a single shipping action to the board (subject to Bene Gesserit Spiritual Advisor advantage).

advantages.text: You control all shipments to and from Dune.

advantages.title: Fold Space: Vulnerable to Karama
advantages.text:
You may take your turn in the Shipping and Movement phase out of turn (both actions in the normal sequence). This allows you to go first, last, or in between other players' turns. The rest of the factions must make their Shipping and Movement actions in the proper sequence. You do not have to reveal when you intend to take your turn until the moment you wish to take it.

Vulnerable to Karama: If canceled by Karama, you must take your turn in normal order. Karama cannot be played after your normal turn order has already passed.

advantages.title: Monopoly
advantages.text: When other factions ship forces onto Dune from their off\-planet reserves, they pay the spice to you instead of the Spice Bank.

advantages.title: Troop Carrier
advantages.text:
As your Force Shipment action you may make one of three types of Force Shipment actions each round, subject to storm and occupancy rules:

\- Ship normally from off\-planet reserves to Dune.

\- Cross\-ship any number of your forces from one territory to any other territory on the board.

\- Ship any number of your forces from one territory back to your reserves.

advantages.title: Guild Rates
advantages.text: You pay only half the normal fee (rounded up) when shipping to or from Dune. For cross\-shipping, you pay normal shipping rates.

fate.title: Karama Power - Blockade
fate.text:
The following one\-time ability is triggered by playing a Karama card:

Stop one off\-planet shipment of any one player.

Spirit World Variant: Weather Control.

### SPECIAL VICTORY CONDITION

If no one has been able to win the game by the end of play, you win if you control as many or more strongholds as whichever faction controls the most strongholds (regardless if that faction is in an alliance). If allied, you and your ally together must be in as many or more strongholds as the faction or alliance controlling the most strongholds.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: Allies may ship from their reserves onto Dune, from Dune back to reserves, or cross\-ship from one territory to another with forces that are already on Dune per your Guild Rates advantage (even the Fremen). Your ally wins with you if you win with your Special Victory Condition.
